description: Hosts whose pages and PDFs are allowed to open INSIDE the ClackOS web browser / PDF reader windows. Links that are local to this website are always allowed. Anything not local and not listed here opens in a real new browser tab instead, so the desktop never shows a blank window when a site refuses to be framed (X-Frame-Options / CSP). Entries match the exact host and any subdomain (e.g. "example.com" also matches "docs.example.com").
